title: approval-gated-module typed input
description: Input for a tenant-scoped external action held behind a named human approval. The approver is required at dispatch, not chosen later: a gate with no named owner is not a gate.

tenantId.description: Tenant the action is scoped to. Required at the boundary — see MEM-7.

approver.description: Who must approve before the effect runs. A named person, not a role.

payload.description: Action-specific body, validated by the action's own step.
